sloka: एवम् विलपमानम् तम् भरतम् दीन मानसम् ।अब्रवीद् वचनम् भूयो वसिष्ठः तु महान् ऋषिः ॥२-७६-१०॥
transliteration: evam vilapamānam tam bharatam dīna mānasam ।abravīd vacanam bhūyo vasiṣṭhaḥ tu mahān ṛṣiḥ ॥2-76-10॥

translations.english: To Bharata who was thus lamenting with a dejected mind, the great ascetic Vasistha once again said:
